## ⭐ Star-First Review Priority

> **Note:** We give **review and merge priority** to contributors who have explored the project and left a ⭐ **Star** on **[viniciusscience/fishid-studio](https://github.com/viniciusscience/fishid-studio)**, as it shows genuine interest and familiarity with our open-source marine science platform (UN SDG 14). When multiple PRs target the same issue, contributors who starred the repository are prioritized!
